entries.title: Browse public pages before joining
entries.description: You can browse public communities and profiles as a guest, preview a community before joining, and choose whether your own profile is public.

entries.title: Log in with Discord or Twitch
entries.description: You can register or log in with Discord or Twitch and manage linked accounts in your settings.

entries.title: React and reply in chat
entries.description: You can reply to individual messages, add emoji reactions, choose emoji from a picker, and edit messages you’ve sent.

entries.title: Show when you’re streaming
entries.description: You can show your Twitch live status, and communities can display a live badge for their linked Twitch channel.

entries.title: Get started on mobile
entries.description: You can register, log in, and view your profile in the mobile app.

entries.title: Search within a community
entries.description: You can search a community’s posts and threads to find a conversation.

entries.title: Messages and updates in the top bar
entries.description: You can reach search, messages, notifications, friend requests, and your account from the top bar. Quick popovers let you check updates, with dedicated pages for messages and friend requests.

entries.title: Choose your availability
entries.description: You can pick Online, Idle, Busy, or Invisible from your account menu. Simple colored dots show people’s status.

entries.title: Post to your wall from Home
entries.description: You can write a post on your own wall from the home feed or choose one of your communities as the destination.

entries.title: Open people and communities with one click
entries.description: You can click anywhere on a person or community card to open its page.
